expectations.text: Uses states() rather than variant() since the flags are independent, not mutually exclusive
expectations.evidence: states({ selected, disabled }) with a comment on declaration-order precedence.

expectations.text: Does not hand-write a separate combined selected+disabled branch
expectations.evidence: Only selected/disabled blocks, no combined branch.

ChipProps is a hand-written interface ({ selected?: boolean; disabled?: boolean }), not derived from StyleProps<typeof chipStates> -- disconnected from the states() definition, unlike iteration 1's without_skill run for this same eval (which did use StyleProps). Inconsistent baseline behavior on this point too.

expectations.text: Colors are semantic tokens, not raw hex
expectations.evidence: background-current, border-secondary, text, background-hover, background-selected, primary, background-disabled, border-disabled, text-disabled -- all semantic. Also correctly uses borderRadius: 'xl', a real valid token (unlike the with_skill run's fabricated 'max').
